lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: GET BACK FROM THE DOOR [beat] BEFORE THAT THING RIPS THROUGH THE REINFORCED STEEL AND TAKES US BOTH OUT!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, I am literally seeing a thermal signature coming from inside a safe [beat] that hasn’t been plugged into a power source for forty years!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Stop shaking the camera and help me wedge this crowbar into the seal [beat] because whatever is breathing in there sounds like it’s running out of oxygen.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I told you boys to never come up here [beat] but since you’ve already broken the lock, you might as well see why our family is so wealthy.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Dada? How long have you been standing in the shadows watching us [beat] and why is your hand glowing the same blue color as the safe’s keypad?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don’t care about the money right now, Grandpa [beat] there is something organic and heavy thumping against the door like a trapped heartbeat!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: That’s not a heartbeat, Nix [beat] that’s the sound of the cooling system failing after you stupidly cut the primary security wires.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The safe door is vibrating so hard my teeth are rattling [beat] and I think I see some kind of black liquid leaking out of the bottom hinge!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s not leaking, it’s reaching out [beat] look at how it’s moving toward your shoes like it’s searching for a heat source to latch onto!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sometimes the things we inherit aren’t family heirlooms [beat] they are biological debts that haven't been paid back yet.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Step into the light, Nix [beat] it’s time you met the person who actually built this house and has been living inside that box since 1954.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The door is falling off the hinges [beat] wait, is that a human hand reaching out from the dark, or is it something much worse?
